list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; no online trophies.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to complete. Work through this atlas in roadmap order, keep manual saves before story missions (the game has no mission replay), and check the 100% completion list after the story for anything left. Expect a long campaign: published roadmaps put the platinum at roughly 200-250 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Follow the on-screen objectives, stay with your partner, and do not worry about speed or style on a first run. It cannot be missed: it is the first mission of the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Play the missions in the order the game presents them and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter in case a one-off feat inside a mission goes wrong. No side content is needed for this trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. The asterisks are part of the official name as published. Before starting the chapter, make a manual save: the game has no mission replay, so a fresh save is your safety net for any feat tied to a single mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Use the time in Vice City to try activities and side strands as they appear, since several later trophies build on them, but nothing extra is required for this chapter trophy itself.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Bank-vault jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, so take that mission when it appears: it feeds the Maximum Withdrawal trophy and the 100% list. Keep a manual save at the chapter start.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission and this gold trophy unlocks when it ends. Make a manual save before starting it, in a separate slot, so the endgame state stays available for free-roam clean-up. After the credits, free roam stays open for the remaining trophies.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow its objectives to the end; the trophy is awarded on mission completion, not on any rating. If a feat inside the mission is attempted at the same time, save beforehand, because missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play it when the story offers it and see it through to the mission-complete screen. Stock up on armour and ammunition before starting, and keep a manual save from just before the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The trophy follows mission completion, so focus on the objectives and surviving the mission rather than on optional feats. Save in a fresh slot before it begins.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Work through its set pieces in order and finish the mission; the trophy unlocks at completion. Keep a manual save beforehand, as with every named story mission, because there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Follow the mission objectives to completion for the trophy. Note the airport's layout while you are there: the Catch Me If You Can feat also takes place at VCIA, so learn its exits and runways.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. See it through to the mission-complete screen for the trophy. Prepare with full health, armour and a ranged loadout before starting, and save in a fresh slot first.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story: open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion view and work down what is left. The checklist covers story, stranger strands, stunts, shooting-range golds, bank vaults and collectibles, so use it as the clean-up list in stage 5 of the roadmap. This gold trophy is the last big gate before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and guides count 397 stunt spots in total while 100% completion needs 300. Chain stunt attempts into normal travel instead of grinding one spot, and keep a fast bike and a plane handy. Track progress in the Stats screen so the last few do not have to be hunted blind.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, as listed by trophy guides. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them. Do this early, in stage 1, so every activity's location is already known when its own trophy comes up.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each challenge's target pattern first with a practice run, then go for gold with headshots and reload discipline rather than speed alone. Work through one weapon class at a time and revisit the hardest challenges last, when your aim and upgrades are best.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates on a first run, then race clean lines and cut corners only where the gates allow it. Visit every location once in stage 4 and tick them off here, so no single far-flung course is left for the end.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: each race event counts once, so variety matters more than repeating one easy win. Mix car, bike and boat races and use the fastest vehicle class allowed for each event. Keep a list of the events already won, since the trophy counts distinct races only.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot first to learn what bites there and which bait the bigger fish take, then take Cal on with the best rod and bait available. Stay patient and keep tension in the safe zone: losing the fish costs the attempt, not the trophy, so retry until the challenge is won.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game in full, from start to its end screen. Pick a short game first, learn its controls in one practice run, then play a clean run through. Arcade cabinets are found in bars and arcades around Leonida; one completed game is all this trophy needs.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until its final mission, then complete that mission. Take every Andy mission as it appears so the strand is not left half-finished at the end of the story. The strand can be finished in free roam after the story, so it is not missable, but finishing it during stage 2 keeps the roadmap tidy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand until its final mission, then complete that mission. Kenton's strand involves boats, so keep a fast boat in mind when his missions call for water travel. It remains available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand until its final mission, then complete that mission. Billy's missions lean on riding, so keep a good bike ready and expect chases. The strand stays open in free roam after the story, so finish it in stage 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every side questline counts, so work through the stranger strands systematically and tick each finished strand off here; guides were still confirming exactly which strands qualify at launch. All strands can be finished after the story in free roam, so sweep the map for stranger markers in stage 2.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's mission strand until its final mission, then complete that mission. Take Randy's missions whenever they appear, since stranger strands are easy to leave half-done. The strand remains available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand until its final mission, then complete that mission. Tyrone's strand is one of the five named stranger finales, so finishing it also feeds Strangers & Freaks. It can be completed in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Visit the spots in a sweep, region by region, and use the prompt at each one; the trophy needs every spot, not just most of them. Guides flag this as the one trophy to watch most carefully, because a missed spot is hard to retrace, so tick each spot off in this tracker as you go and keep a manual save before long sweeps.
trophies.missableWhy: All 18 spots must be found; a spot passed without meditating is easy to lose track of, so tick each one off as you visit it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Mobalytics — Grand Theft Auto 6 All Trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Find Bret, take his hunt, and track the animal with the hunting clues the game gives rather than wandering the wilds at random. Bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind; the animal is unique, so a failed attempt should be retried from a manual save made just before the hunt.
trophies.missableWhy: The animal is unique: save before the hunt so a botched attempt can be retried from the save.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. Cards are found across Leonida in shops, machines and hidden spots, so pick up every card you pass and check set progress often. Finish the three easiest sets first, then work on the rest only if the 100% list requires them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app to scan 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Open the app at every landmark you pass and scan before moving on, working region by region so the count climbs steadily. The in-game counter shows progress; when it stalls, move to a new region rather than rescanning old spots.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and activities, so they accumulate naturally if you vary what you do. Check the challenge list regularly and steer toward the nearly-finished ones in stage 4, rather than leaving all 50 to a final grind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. Use the countryside and water to break line of sight, swap vehicles once the heat is off your tail, and stay together until the stars clear. Save before starting, since a failed escape means rebuilding the wanted level from scratch.
trophies.missableWhy: Needs your partner present and a 4-star escape in one run; save first, and attempt it while the partner is available in free roam.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level between them: the level must be kept alive across all three robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving so the police stay engaged but never catch you. A getaway driver position and a fast car make the chain far easier.
trophies.missableWhy: All 3 robberies must chain without the wanted level dropping; one escape or arrest breaks the chain, so save first and plan the route.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Drive, ride or fly anything new you see: entering a new model counts as a discovery, so vary vehicles on every trip instead of sticking to one favourite. Car meets, docks, airfields and dealerships are the fastest places to find models you have not driven yet.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster, trigger Combat Focus with full meter, and chain the takedowns without letting the meter run out. Use cover and a high-damage weapon, and retry from a manual save if the fifth target falls after the focus ends.
trophies.missableWhy: All 5 takedowns must land inside one Combat Focus; save before a busy fight and attempt it where enemies group together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: get a plane moving and leave the airport without following a scheduled departure. Steal or board an aircraft on the tarmac, take off promptly, and clear the airport airspace. Attempt it in free roam with a manual save first, since airport security responds fast.
trophies.missableWhy: A one-off stunt at a guarded airport; save before entering VCIA so a failed attempt can be retried cleanly.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks as the description hints: get inside the heat of a Rhino encounter and survive it. Use heavy weapons and cover, keep moving so the cannon cannot track you, and use the environment for protection. Save before the encounter and retry from the save if the attempt goes wrong.
trophies.missableWhy: A single tank encounter: go in prepared and saved, since the trophy is tied to that one confrontation.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Scout the store first, learn guard and camera positions, move quietly, and take the goods without raising an alarm. If you are spotted, reload a manual save made just before entering rather than finishing the robbery detected.
trophies.missableWhy: One detection voids the attempt; save outside the store and reload on any alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and 100% completion needs all of them, so plan to hit all 8. For each vault, escape cleanly before moving to the next, and use a fast getaway vehicle parked nearby.
trophies.missableWhy: Each vault needs a clean escape; take the Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank jobs, and save between vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, stop it without destroying the cargo, take the money, and lose any wanted level before the trophy counts as complete. A roadblock vehicle and a fast getaway car, parked in advance, make the escape reliable.
trophies.missableWhy: The robbery and the escape are one attempt; save first and have the getaway ready before stopping the truck.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole map is revealed. Drive, sail and fly into every corner, including islands and backroads, and watch the area name appear on screen as each new area registers. Work region by region in stage 3 and finish with the map's edges, where the last few areas usually hide.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Learn which operations belong to which gang from the game's markers and contacts, then hit one per gang and escape each time. Keep a checklist of the gangs already hit, since the trophy needs all 9, not just 9 robberies.
trophies.missableWhy: One operation per gang, 9 gangs in total; track the gangs already hit and save between operations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view: sit or stand where the beach and ocean are in front of you and take the drink. This is a quiet moment trophy, so do it in free roam when you are passing the beach anyway. The trophy unlocks once the cocktail moment plays out.
trophies.missableWhy: A single quiet moment at one beach spot; do it deliberately in free roam rather than hoping to stumble on it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a vehicle, in classic style: drive straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a strong car, line up a clear run through the showroom, and commit at speed. Save outside first, since the attempt draws attention fast.
trophies.missableWhy: One smash-out attempt at one showroom; save outside and line the run up before committing.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a bowl: play a frame and complete the follow-through motion the game asks for. It is a small activity trophy, so take it while you are in the area for other activities. One completed follow-through is enough.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Reach the partnership moment this cryptic description points to: play the story with your partner and take the choices that build the partnership's public appeal. Keep both characters' standing strong and follow the partner missions as they appear. Because the trigger is a story moment, keep manual saves through the late story so it can be revisited if the moment passes.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to a story partnership moment; keep late-story manual saves so the moment can be revisited.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse, until the tracked count reaches 500. Choices appear in missions, conversations and free-roam decisions, so the count climbs across a full playthrough if you engage with them instead of skipping dialogue. Check the tracked count in Stats and finish the remainder in free roam by seeking out choice moments.
trophies.missableWhy: The 500-choice count is cumulative across the whole run; skipping dialogue early makes the tail longer, so engage with choices from the start.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something that first went wrong: fail an attempt, then succeed on the immediate retry. The natural way is to attempt a challenge or feat, fail it once, and then complete it on the next try without leaving the activity. Do not avoid failure entirely; this trophy wants the comeback.
trophies.missableWhy: Needs a failure followed by a success on the retry; if everything is reloaded before failing, the trigger never fires, so attempt a retryable challenge naturally.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange, unscripted moments: the description points to a random event that surprises the player. Roam the state, respond to odd sights and encounters, and investigate anything unusual instead of driving past it. It unlocks when the strange event plays out, so keep roaming varied areas until it triggers.
trophies.missableWhy: A random strange event; it is missed only by rushing past odd encounters, so stop and investigate anything unusual.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock the target down. Slow the vehicle to a steady pass, line up the target, and swing as you pass. Practice on a quiet road with a manual save first, since speed and timing decide the hit.
trophies.missableWhy: One clean melee hit from a moving vehicle; practice the timing on a quiet road with a save ready.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Earn marked bills from robberies and jobs, then pass them through contacts regularly instead of hoarding them, so the total climbs across the whole run. The trophy counts the cumulative amount laundered, not money held at once.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy weapons, clothes, food and upgrades as you play, and the total climbs naturally; top it up in stage 5 with useful purchases rather than throwaway spending. The count is cumulative across every shop, so no single purchase needs to be large.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Save money through the story, watch for properties coming on the market, and buy each garage as funds allow. Buying all 8 also gives storage across the map, so prioritise the garages near the activities you use most.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one; variety is not required, just 10 registrations. Pair this with vehicle discovery in stage 3, registering each new model as you find it.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
SixShore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements List
